caption: Soap bubbles drift past a balloon that has been rubbed on wool, and they curve toward the balloon and cling to it.

sa.check: A balloon that has been rubbed on wool.
Soap bubbles drift past the balloon.
The bubbles curve toward the balloon.
The bubbles cling to the balloon.
The bubbles are drifting through the air before they near the balloon.
The drift comes first and the curve and cling follow.

pc.expect: Bubbles change course toward the balloon only when they come near it; bubbles far from the balloon drift straight on; none curves away from it.
pc.fail: A bubble curves away from the balloon; or bubbles far across the room swerve toward it; or a bubble changes course with the balloon nowhere near; or bubbles circle the balloon in the air.

pc.expect: Bubbles that reach the balloon stick to its surface or pop on it; those stuck stay where they land.
pc.fail: A bubble reaches the balloon and bounces off to drift on; or hangs a gap from the balloon without touching; or stuck bubbles slide about on the balloon; or bubbles pass through the balloon and out the other side.

pc.expect: Away from the balloon the bubbles drift and sink slowly; none rise steadily away or hang fixed in the air.
pc.fail: Bubbles rise steadily to the ceiling with nothing blowing them; or hang fixed in the air; or fall like stones.

pc.expect: The bubbles are thin films that wobble, cling as a dome and pop into nothing; the balloon keeps its round shape.
pc.fail: A bubble bounces like a rubber ball; or keeps its shape after popping; or the balloon dents deeply and stays dented; or a bubble passes into the balloon as a solid ball.

pc.expect: One balloon; bubbles vanish only by popping; none appear from nowhere in mid-air near the balloon; the balloon passes through nothing.
pc.fail: Bubbles appear from nowhere beside the balloon; or a bubble vanishes without popping in mid-drift; or the balloon duplicates or vanishes; or the balloon passes through a wall or table.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The balloon's colour and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The balloon changes colour or size; or the room's contents rearrange; or the bubbles change colour.

note: Who blows the bubbles or holds the balloon is not judged.
